title: Two concurrent opens race to create the subsample cache directory
body:
`cache_dir` in `libsufr/src/typed.rs` checks whether `~/.sufr` is a directory and calls `fs::create_dir` when it is not. Two threads that open a file with a search-time cap at the same time both see no directory, and the second `create_dir` fails with `File exists (os error 17)`.

In `libsufr/tests/search.rs` the tests `the_cap_at_search_time_bounds_the_comparison` and `a_cap_of_zero_at_search_time_means_the_files_cap` share one temporary `HOME` and run in parallel, so `cargo test --workspace` fails about one run in ten with that error on one of them.

## Proposal

`fs::create_dir_all`, which returns `Ok` when the directory exists. Whether the cache lives there at all is sufr-22b9c3.
close_reason: Fixed in the commit "Create the subsample cache directory with create_dir_all" on refactor: create_dir_all returns Ok when the directory exists. The two tests in libsufr/tests/search.rs that raced were removed with the build-time cap in b3f9104, and the search tests passed 60 runs of 60 before the fix, so the race no longer shows in the suite.
